statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
These symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential ectopic beats or conduction abnormalities over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2
The service was denied with reason code CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under Federal Medicare guidelines
The clinical documentation provided did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring over the specified period
